_comment: Copy these hooks into your project's (or better, USER-level) .claude/settings.json so the citation-verifier gate is un-skippable. citation_arm.py (UserPromptSubmit) arms a verification task from your wording; citation_verify_stop.py (Stop) blocks the turn until a signed run exists — and, when a manuscript is known and the `claude` CLI is present, launches the autonomous runner itself. Provide the signing secret to the HOOK environment ONLY (not the agent's shell), ideally via a file: export CITATION_VERIFIER_SIGNING_KEY_FILE=/etc/citation-verifier/signing.key . Keep these in user-level settings so the agent cannot disable them by editing the repo.
